name: Improved Pull (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Pull, Str 13

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to the free combat maneuver check granted when you use the pull ability.

The distance you pull a victim closer in a round with a successful check set by this ability is doubled. For example, 5 ft. becomes 10 ft.
